subtitle: A budget app you can update by saying what you spent.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with monthly budgets and spending by category. Tell your AI what you spent, or add expenses yourself and see what's left.

ask.prompt: Set up the budget and expenses template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Log what you spent
slides.ai: Added it to Eating out. You have 2,541 kr left this month.
slides.alt: November in the budget: 2,541 kr left, with each category against its budget

slides.label: Ask how it's going
slides.you: How am I doing this month?
slides.ai: 2,541 kr left of 6,300 kr. Transport is nearly used up, with 10 kr left.
slides.alt: The month on iPhone: 2,541 kr left, Transport at 790 of 800 kr

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or add and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: The budget per category, ready to change
